applies_to.selection: the version the capture discovered with copilot --version

executor: journal-ocsf-writer CopilotUsageReportMapper (direct Java); the whole document is one record

time_policy.reported: none (sessionStartTime is the session's start, not the report's time)
time_policy.fallback: latest preceding reported time, else capture start

identity: copilot.usage_report.identity.v1: the report names no session; it belongs to the execution whose launch named the file (bound by acquisition)

rules.owner: session usage from tokenDetails (scope 5, final, cumulative snapshot) and per model from modelMetrics (scope 6); totalPremiumRequestCost as kind 2, totalNanoAiu as kind 4

rules.selector: a record that is not one JSON object

rules.owner: the record retained whole with the failure

candidate.status: EXPERIMENTAL candidate (2026-10-24): tested on one sanitized live 1.0.100 run (copilot-otel-1) and its final assembly; not admitted: no field-disposition catalog or oracle profile yet; tested candidate behaviour is not approved support
